test_create_session: test SessionManager.create_session to create a new session with a working directory and return a SessionState object
test_fork_session: test SessionManager.fork_session to deep-copy a session's history and create a new session with a unique ID
test_list_sessions: test SessionManager.list_sessions to list non-empty sessions filtered by cwd and sorted by most recent activity
test_persistence: test SessionManager persistence to verify sessions survive process restarts via SessionDB restore from database
test_cleanup_remove: test SessionManager.cleanup and remove_session to clear all sessions and remove individual sessions from memory and database
